translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Mer yogasaar be sogo, we dule-iskanaye
Jesús sogdebar: “Mer yogsaar be sogo, we dule-iskanaye, adi melle Bab Dummad deyob begi sogmogagar.
Ar dulemargi be sogsadyobi, begi soglemogoed, degine, dulemarga be igar-mesisadyobi, bega igar-megnonimogoed.
“¿Ar ibiga be-gwenad-ibyagi durgan-maid magar be dake, ar be-ibya-yaba suar-maiddi aku be dake?
¿Ar igi be-gwenadga be sogoe: ‘Be-ibya-yaba durgan-maid an bega onogweloye,’ ar be-ibya-yaba suar maiddina?
“¡Ar bemar wagar-darbomalad! Suar be-ibya-yaba maid-insa be onoge, geb agi nabir be atakoed, be-gwenad-ibya-yaba durgan-maid onogegar.

“Ar ibmar-nuegan-swilidikmalad mer be achumarga ukmar, ar abakalegi degir begi aibinnalile, degine, be-san ichimakalile. Degine, morbeb-akwagiid-nuegan mer be sinmarga mimar, ar abakalegi degir egi annaarmalale.”
Bab Dummadse be egise, ar bega ukoed
Jesús sogdebar: “Be Bab Dummadse ibmar egismar, Bab Dummad bega ukmaloed; be Bab Dummadse ibmar amimar, be amimaloed; be Bab Dummadse gormar, bega Bab Dummad yawagak egaoed.
“Ar dule-ibmar-bela-egised, ibmar abingaed; ar dule-ibmar-amiedi, ibmar amied; ar dule-yawagakgi-dulese-goledi, ega yawagak egaleged.
“¿Ar doa-dule emi bemarse be-mimmi madu egichialile, ega be akwa ukmaloe?
¿Igi, bese ua egichiar-dibe, ega bemar naibe ukmaloe? Suli.
Ar bemarde dulemar-iskana-inigwele, be-mimmiganga ibmar-nuegan-uked be wismaladde, ¿ar be-Bab-nibneggi-maid bursunna, dulemar-ese-ibmar-egismaladga ibmar-nuegan ukosur be insae? Ukoe.
“Degisoggu, dulemar igi ibmar bega imakbi be abege, deyob ega ibmarmar be imakmodo. Ar weyob Moisés igar-mesisad, degi, weyob Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad sogsamogad.”
Yawagak-garagwad
Jesús sogdebar: “Yawagak-waragwagwadba be dogmar, ar ade yawagak matar-dummadid, igar mata-bipisulid, yoggued-negse dulemar-semaid, degine, bukidar agi dulemar bur dogmalad.
“Ar yawagak garaa gued, degine, igar garaa gubalid, adi durgued-negse dulemar-semaid, unnila bokwagwa a-yawagak amimalad.”
Dule e-daedgi mag be dakmaloed
Jesús sogdebar: “Nue salakarmar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad-sunnadsurmaladgi, ar amar yamo sibad-wawaadyob nonidamalad, ar e-ulubgindi achu-burburudyob sabsur-damalad-dulemalad.
“A-dulemar e-daedgi be dakmaloed. ¿Ar ade ikogi uva sanmaksi, degi, higode iko-sapigi welesi? Suli, degisuli.
Ar deyobdo, sapi-nuegana, e-durba nueganbi sanmakmodo, ar sapi-iskanadi, e-durba-sanmaked iskanabimodo.
Ar sapi-nuedi geg e-durba iskana sanmaked, degine, sapi-iskana geg e-durba nued sanmakmogad.
“Ar sapimar e-durba nued sanmaksulile, olaodo, soogi metodo, ogumakegar.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad-sunnadsurmalad e-daedgi mag be dakmaloed.”
Bab-negse bela dulemar dogosulid
Jesús sogdebar: “Ar bela dulemar anga-sogedba: ‘Dummad, Dummad,’ degi-anga-sogedba Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidse gwen dogosulid. Dulemar an-Bab-nibneggi-maid-sogedba ibmar-saedba nibneggi dogmaloed.
“Bukidar a-ibagangi anga sogdamaloed. ‘Dummad, ¿ar be-nuggine anmar sunmaksasursi, be-nuggi anmar bukidar niamar-onosmarsursi, degine, be-nuggine bukidar ibmar-dakledisurmalad anmar imaksamarsursi?’
Geb degi an abin-sogoed: ‘Gwen an be-wichur, aku an be-dake, be angi bangumar, unnila bemar-ibmar-iskana-saedginbi-arbadimalad.’”
Dulemar neg-sobedgi Jesús sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebar: “Ar doa-dule we-an-sunmaked itos-dibe, degine, eba daele, we-dule, dule-binsaed-nikaa daedyobdo, na e-neg akwa-birgi sobsayobdo.
Di-wiargu, diwarmar noar, burwamar binnasur gollar, bela-bela a-neggi signonigu, a-neg gwen aimukussur, ar ade neg akwa-birgi sobar siid.
“Degine, ar doa-dule we an-sunmaked itos-dibe, degite eba ibmar imaksasulile, we-dule, dule-binsaedsuli-gusayob guodo, na e-neg ukub-birgi sobsayobdo.
Di-wiargu, diwarmar noar, burwamar binnasur gollar, bela-bela a-neggi signonigu, neg ayarid, a-neg nue-dummad bibichisdo. Be itogua.”
Ar Jesús wegi-ibmar-sogsad-sorba, dulemar geger dakmardo, weyob Jesús e-ibmar odurdaked.
Ar ade Jesús na ibmar odurdaked, escribamar odurdakeyob odurdaksulid, edi na nue-wisi odurdaked.
